desc:
⚔️ Promote to Champion ⚔️

Train your champion, equip them properly, and watch them unleash their abilities in spectacular battles!

• Climb the arenas, crush waves of enemies, and defeat bosses
• Summon races and abilities, from Common to Mythic
• Build your style: weapons, gear, stats, and auras
• Challenge other players in PvP duels

🔜 Coming Soon: Infinite Tower and 2v2 PvP!

🎨 VFX or animation artist? Want to help the game grow? Join our community!
